title: Acronym Without The Small Words
description:
## Task

Build an acronym from a sentence. Take the first letter of every word that has three or more characters, turn it into uppercase, and join the letters in order. Words with one or two characters are skipped.

## Input

- `sentence` — words separated by one or more spaces. It may be empty or contain only spaces.

## Output

A string of uppercase letters, possibly empty.

## Example

```python
acronym_big_words("the lord of the rings")  # returns "TLTR"
acronym_big_words("a to be or not")  # returns "N"
acronym_big_words("")  # returns ""
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `sentence` ≤ 10^4
- Words contain letters only; the first letter of a counted word is a letter `a`-`z` or `A`-`Z`.
